summary: 3D simit bakery tycoon on an old Istanbul street, redesigned as a hand-painted 2.5D bakery with a chalkboard UI, built by Claude Sonnet 5.5 · Eski bir İstanbul sokağında 3D simit fırını işletme oyunu, el boyaması 2.5D fırın ve kara tahta arayüzüyle yeniden tasarlandı, Claude Sonnet 5.5 yaptı
key_features: A full production chain: knead, shape, dip in molasses, roll in sesame and bake; an unattended oven burns the bread
Redesign: painted textures, a wood-fired oven glow with flicker, steam and flour dust, cobblestones, blue-shutter houses and a simit cart
Redesign: chalkboard menus with a self-hosted chalk font, a wooden top bar and a baker-paper receipt for the day summary; phone portrait and landscape layouts
Simit sellers carry trays to the pier, the school, the park, the office and the tea houses; demand follows the hour and the weather
Measured after the redesign: 60 fps in play, 20 -> 28 draw calls; the ?auto bot wins on day 17 with 0 JS errors

social.headline: Run a simit bakery in Istanbul: bake, staff the oven and send simit sellers across town · İstanbul'da simit fırını işlet: fırınla, ustaları yerleştir, simitçileri sokağa gönder
